(Presently Lodged In District - Sub  Jail Kusalgarh, Banswara.)
 ----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Jhumiya D/o Shri Dhuliya, Resident Of Village -  Gokulpada, P.s. Patan, District Banswara (Rajasthan).
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Shambhoo Singh  Mr. Hitendra Singh For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 15/12/2023 1.
The jurisdiction of this Court has been invoked by way of filing an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. at the instance of accused-petitioners.

Date of passing of impugned order 28.11.2023 [2023:RJ-JD:44015] (2 of 3)
Despite intimation regarding hearing of bail plea, no one has put in appearance on behalf of the victim/complainant.
3. It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioners that no case for the alleged offences is made out against them and their incarceration is not warranted.
There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of bail to the accused-petitioners and they have been made an accused based on conjectures and surmises.

4. Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.
5. I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and have perused the material available on record.
There is no allegation of molestation or outraging the modesty.
The only allegation is for abduction for the purpose of marrying off or sexual desire, but no further act has been done.
There is high probability that the trial may take long time to conclude.
In light of these facts and circumstances, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioners in the present matter.

6. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused- [2023:RJ-JD:44015] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-15533/2023] petitioners as named in the cause title shall be enlarged on bail provided each of them furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(FARJAND ALI),J 478-Pramod/-
